description: Handwritten scenarios over the goal transitions, each step at its store time with what the transaction reads of the run (its head as checkpoint text, its waits and jobs as far as a goal reads them, its lease), and the record each scenario ends with. A step that names refused is refused with that reason.

scenarios.name: a life: commands, refusals, repeats, a bind and an achievement
an abandon records what it left; its deliveries are journaled; a create waits for its waits
past the journal's bound refusals go first, and a command is never refused for size
